description: This is a Java service class implementing business logic for managing user-created bookshelves in a book tracking application.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting user-created bookshelves, as well as retrieving books in a specific shelf.

methods.name: createCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates a new UserCreatedShelf object with the provided shelf name associated with the current user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a UserCreatedShelf by its ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Returns all shelves associated with the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Finds a UserCreatedShelf by its name for the current user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided UserCreatedShelf to the repository, throwing an exception if a shelf with the same name exists.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of user-created shelves.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns shelves filtered by name, or all if null.

methods.name: getBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Retrieves all books in the specified custom shelf by name.

methods.name: getCustomShelfByName
methods.description: Retrieves a custom shelf entity by name, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: findOrCreate
methods.description: Finds a shelf by name, or creates it if it does not exist, associated with the current user.

methods.name: shelfNameExists
methods.description: Checks whether a shelf name is a predefined shelf or already exists.
